title: DOJ Charges 10 Migrants with Illegal Voting, Election Crimes in Nationwide Bust
text:
Stated Claim / Post Context:
DOJ Charges 10 Migrants with Illegal Voting, Election Crimes in Nationwide Bust

The Department of Justice (DOJ) announced charges against 10 migrants, including illegal aliens, for alleged illegal voting and other election crimes in a nationwide bust.
The post DOJ Charges 10 Migrants with Illegal Voting, Election Crimes in Nationwide Bust appeared first on Breitbart.
